name: spinocerebellar ataxia, autosomal recessive, with axonal neuropathy 2
description: A rare autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia (ARCA), characterized by progressive cerebellar ataxia associated with frequent oculomotor apraxia, severe neuropathy and an elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) level.
